reviews.title: Spelling Mistake
reviews.text: There is a spelling mistake in the last word of the 3rd verse of Surah Al Fateha. Please correct. I tried contacting through the app and sent couple of messages but no response so had to leave a review here.

reviews.title: Not compatible to iOS 12
reviews.text: Please bring Quran option in iOS. Not showing on my iPad mini 2

reviews.title: Not accessible for blind people
reviews.text:
During the new update of the application, the prayer times that were updated in the play timing section are not responsive. As a visually impaired person, the screen reader is unable to read them.

Please fix this issue. Previously, it was working properly with the screen reader and it was reading all the text.

reviews.title: Prayer for baby boy??
reviews.text: How does having a prayer for baby boy on this app in accordance with Islam? Are you sure, all other info is correct or that’s a cultural made up trap as well?
